organizations_motto_length.name: organizations_motto_length
organizations_motto_length.value: "organizations"."motto" is null or char_length("organizations"."motto") between 1 and 80

categories_years_check.name: categories_years_check
categories_years_check.value: "categories"."birth_year_from" is null or "categories"."birth_year_to" is null or "categories"."birth_year_from" <= "categories"."birth_year_to"

accounting_links_synced_external_check.name: accounting_links_synced_external_check
accounting_links_synced_external_check.value: "accounting_links"."status" not in ('synced', 'cancelled') or "accounting_links"."external_id" is not null

challenges_dates_check.name: challenges_dates_check
challenges_dates_check.value: "challenges"."starts_on" is null or "challenges"."ends_on" is null or "challenges"."ends_on" >= "challenges"."starts_on"

player_loads_origin_check.name: player_loads_origin_check
player_loads_origin_check.value: ("player_loads"."source" = 'session' and "player_loads"."event_id" is not null) or ("player_loads"."source" = 'match' and "player_loads"."match_id" is not null) or ("player_loads"."source" = 'extra' and "player_loads"."event_id" is null and "player_loads"."match_id" is null)

wellness_entries_scale_check.name: wellness_entries_scale_check
wellness_entries_scale_check.value: "wellness_entries"."sleep" between 1 and 5 and "wellness_entries"."fatigue" between 1 and 5 and "wellness_entries"."soreness" between 1 and 5 and "wellness_entries"."stress" between 1 and 5 and "wellness_entries"."mood" between 1 and 5

suggestions_public_title_check.name: suggestions_public_title_check
suggestions_public_title_check.value: not ("suggestions"."status" in ('open', 'planned', 'in_progress', 'released')) or "suggestions"."public_title" is not null
